title: 华尔兹

series.next: Saturday. Two hundred neighbours, and the speaker won't play.

setting: 金桂苑, Thursday, 9 pm. The talent show is on Saturday.

giveup.zh: 小邻居不说话，就是同意了。
giveup.en: Our young neighbour's gone quiet. That's a yes, then.
By morning your name is on the programme, in red. Run that back. 🍉

wu.name: 吴阿姨
wu.en: 3号楼: knows someone who saw it

zhao.name: 赵奶奶
zhao.en: eighty, sends only sixty-second voice notes

steps.narr: Thursday night. The estate's group chat.

steps.zh: 我发现，小邻居每天七点也出门……
steps.en: I've noticed our young neighbour goes out at seven every evening too...

else.zh: 老周加油！方阿姨加油！金桂苑第一！
else.en: Go 老周! Go 方阿姨! 金桂苑 number one!

steps.zh: 坏消息：方阿姨膝盖不行了，跳不了了。
steps.en: Bad news: 方阿姨's knee has gone. She can't dance.

steps.zh: 投票：谁替方阿姨跳？小邻居，十二票。
steps.en: Vote: who replaces 方阿姨? Young neighbour: twelve votes.
Young neighbour, you've got the most votes!

say.en: Politely refuse: you really can't dance.
answers: 我真的不会跳舞，别投我了。
谢谢大家，可我真的不会跳舞。
我真的不会跳，大家别投我。
say.gloss: I really can't dance. Please don't vote for me.
say.tip: 不会 bú huì = can't (never learned): 我不会跳舞.

ok.zh: 我年轻的时候跳得可好了，我教你。
ok.en: I was a wonderful dancer in my day. I'll teach you.

answers: 谢谢大家抬举，可我真的不会跳舞。
谢谢大家抬举，我是真的不会跳舞。
4.gloss: You flatter me, everyone, but I truly can't dance.
4.tip: 抬举 táiju = think highly of: 谢谢大家抬举, the modest way out.

steps.en: Young neighbour: just one song, please?

say.gloss: All right. One song, and only one.
say.tip: 首 shǒu = the measure word for songs: 一首歌. 只 zhǐ = only.

answers: 丑话说在前头，我只跳一首。
丑话说在前面，我只跳一首。
4.gloss: Let's be clear from the start: one song, no more.
4.tip: 丑话说在前头 = say the ugly words first: set your terms up front.

say.en: Better idea: get 婷婷 to do it.
answers: 婷婷，你来吧！你跳得肯定比我好。
say.gloss: 婷婷, you do it! You'd be better than me, surely.
say.tip: 你来吧 = you do it, you take it: handing something over.

answers: 肥水不流外人田，婷婷，你来吧！
婷婷，肥水不流外人田，你来吧！
4.gloss: Keep it in the family, 婷婷. You do it!
4.tip: 肥水不流外人田 = good water doesn't flow to other people's fields: keep a good thing in the family.

steps.zh: 我妈以前最爱跳华尔兹。她走了三年了。
steps.en: My mum loved to waltz. She's been gone three years.

steps.zh: 我爸是为她学的。他谁也没说。
steps.en: Dad's learning it for her. He never told anyone.

steps.narr: The group goes quiet. For once.

steps.en: Young neighbour, what do you say?

say.en: Dance it yourself, or ask 婷婷 to dance with her dad.
say.gloss: All right, I'll dance! I'll start learning now.
say.tip: 就 jiù = right away: 我现在就去.

ok.zh: 谢谢你，小邻居。明晚七点，公园。
ok.en: Thank you, young neighbour. Tomorrow, seven, the park.

alts.en: Or: 婷婷 dances with her dad
alts.gloss: 婷婷, dance with your dad.

fail.en: Young neighbour, what do you say?

answers: 我跳！不会可以学，我今晚就练。
好，我跳，不会就学，今晚就练。
4.gloss: I'll dance! I'll learn. Starting tonight.

answers: 婷婷，这支舞，应该你陪你爸跳。
婷婷，这支舞该你陪你爸跳。
alts.gloss: 婷婷, this dance should be yours, with your dad.

steps.en: Friday, 7 pm, the park: 老周 teaches you the waltz. You step on his foot twice. He doesn't mind. 💃

else.en: 老周 sends a thumbs-up. A minute later, a second one. 💃
